description: Returns one business record by its id (from search_records) or, for a listed record, its page slug: the name, address, coordinates, status, chain flag, page URL (the place page when listed, else the record page at /records/<slug>), and every fact with its source, method and check date, plus actions: the URL where the owner claims the business. Give id or slug, not both. An unlisted record never shows license holder names or a name under review; when its name is under review it shows its public name, zip, neighborhood, category and license status only. An unknown id or slug returns { "error": "not_found" }.

id.description: Record id, a UUID that search_records returns.

slug.description: Page slug of a listed record, for example tracks-tavern.

name: get_record
